name: Jungle Clash
summary:
Jungle Clash is a MOBA (multiplayer online battle arena) that's quite similar to the popular Clash Royale. In it you play against other players online in hectic battles featuring the characters from Jungle Heat. This means you can use grenadiers, snipers, storm troopers, fighter jets, etc.

The game system in Jungle Clash is simple and straightforward. You start out each round with three towers: one central tower and two side ones. Your aim is to use your troops to destroy your opponent's central tower, while defending your own towers at the same time. Each round lasts three minutes and the winner is the player who destroys the most towers.
